item.description: For Quebecers, waiting to buy a home feels like the bigger risk when it comes to price, according to latest RBC Home Ownership Poll. Two-thirds (66%) worry that holding off on buying will leave them priced out if prices rise, compared to only 34% who worry about buying now only to see prices fall.
item.title: Two-thirds of Quebecers worry waiting to buy will price them out of the market: RBC Home Ownership Poll

item.description: Multi-generational living is on the table for many Canadians looking to buy a home, according to RBC's latest Home Ownership Poll. The research found that 53% of those planning to purchase their first or next home within the next two years would consider a multi-generational home (44% of all respondents). Among current owners, 35% say they would sell their current home and buy one with their child to help them get into the market.
item.title: Pooling Resources: 53% of prospective buyers would consider a multi-generational home according to latest RBC Home Ownership Poll
